description: The only recordings agents/llm.py::chat() may replay when the exact fixture is missing. Each was recorded before max_tokens joined the cache key (b4ef009) and is pinned by the sha256 of its bytes. chat() also checks in code that the recording answers this request apart from max_tokens, was not cut off (finish_reason stop/tool_calls), used fewer tokens than the cap now requested, and came from the requested model. Anything else is not replayed.
